as_told.title: Wilbert Smith top secret memo: flying saucers classified two points higher than the H-bomb

plain: The story is about a top secret Canadian government memo from 1950, written by a man named Wilbert B. Smith, saying that the US government took flying saucers very seriously. The UFO researcher Steven Greer says the memo "accidentally got declassified" and that he included it in a briefing document of his own. A researcher named Grant Cameron gives what it says. Smith reported that flying saucers exist and are "the most highly classified subject in the United States," rated "two points higher than the H-bomb." Cameron links the memo to people named Robert Sarbacher, Vannevar Bush and Omond Solandt. Both men describe the memo from their research rather than from having been involved. They tell it because, if the memo is what they say, it would be an official paper showing that in 1950 the US ranked UFOs above its most secret weapon.
